Name: StardewConfigMenu
Author: Juice805
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://github.com/StardewConfigFramework/StardewConfigMenu/raw/master/docs/menu-optimized.gif[/img]

[font=Verdana][size=6][b]StardewConfigMenu[/b][/size][/font][/center][color=#e06666][b][size=2] 
[/size][/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]StardewConfigMenu allows modders to easily add mod options [u]in-game[/u] without forcing users to modify settings files. The mod adds a Mod Options tab to the main menu which shows the settings of all mods which use the framework.

The framework allows modders to easily attach to StardewConfigMenu and create an options page for their mods without fighting with other mods for screen space. 

For a lot more information check out git repo for the [url=https://github.com/StardewConfigMenu/StardewConfigMenu]Menu[/url], [url=https://github.com/StardewConfigMenu/StardewConfigFramework]Framework[/url] and it's [url=https://github.com/StardewConfigMenu/StardewConfigFramework/wiki]Wiki[/url].
[/size][/color]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Included in this version (>1.0.0):[/b]
[/size][/color][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Category Labels[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Buttons[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Checkboxes[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Plus/Minus Steppers[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Dropdowns (With optional hover text)[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Sliders[/size][/color]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]
Dependent on demand support for other components such as keybinds, or textboxes may be added. Maybe even tabs like CJB Cheat menu. If your mod needs a new component, open an issue on GitHub or send me a message.
[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Mods Using Framework:
[/b][/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Check the Requirements section above this description for Mods requiring this Menu.
[/size][/color]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]MODDERS[/size][size=4]:[/size][/color]
[/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=3] I am looking for your feedback! If there are any problems or concerns with the framework please don't hesitate to contact me ([url=https://discord.gg/aQ9UEjv]Discord[/url]). Check out the [url=https://github.com/StardewConfigMenu/StardewConfigFramework/wiki/getting-started]Getting Started[/url] page for an introduction to the framework.
[/size][/color]﻿[center][color=#e06666]﻿[b][size=2]Please endorse and sh[/size][/b][b][size=2]are this framework with developers if you feel a unified Option Tab would be useful![/size][/b][/color][/center]

Downloads.Description:
The mod. Adds an empty Mod Options Tab to the main menu. To add options to the menu download a compatible mod.

Only compatible with mods adopting framework version >= 2.0.0

SMAPI >= 2.6

Manifest.Description: Allows modders easy access to a unified configuration menu.
